guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: “The strength of our year-to-date performance supported improvements to all of our full-year same-store and FFO guidance ranges,” commented Chief Financial Officer Tim Martin. “Subsequent to the quarter, we advanced a series of liquidity-enhancing transactions that showcase our access to a wide range of capital sources and provide additional flexibility to allocate capital where we see compelling long-term value.”

The Company estimates that its fully diluted earnings per share for 2026 will be between $1.60 and $1.62, and that its fully diluted FFO per share, as adjusted, for 2026 will be between $2.58 and $2.60. Due to uncertainty related to the timing and terms of transactions, the impact of any potential future speculative investment activity is excluded from guidance. For 2026, the same-store pool consists of 623 properties totaling 45.2 million rentable square feet.
